sql_templates.description: Compare signal outcomes against the latest EOD market data and stage snapshots.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_signals AS (SELECT * FROM signals.signal_log WHERE date_issued >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'), 
 latest_eod AS (SELECT * FROM market.equity_eod WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod) AND series = 'EQ'), 
 latest_stage AS (SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)) 
 SELECT ls.symbol, ls.hit_target, ls.hit_stop, ls.return_pct, le.close AS latest_close, ss.stage 
 FROM latest_signals ls 
 JOIN latest_eod le ON ls.symbol = le.symbol 
 JOIN latest_stage ss ON ls.symbol = ss.symbol 
 WHERE ls.return_pct IS NOT NULL;

synthesis_guidance: Provide a clear summary of winners and failures from signal outcomes and suggest potential improvements for future signal selection. Capture these insights in an action watchlist format.
title: Signal Outcome Feedback Review Variant 1817
